nutrition_source_note: The row prices the whole 15.5 oz can (439 g net) at edible_fraction 1.0, so the undrained solids-and-liquids basis is the only arithmetically coherent match, the same convention already used for Canned kidney beans. FDC 175188 is undrained: its water 75.6 g and protein 6.03 g/100 g sit below the drained-and-rinsed Foundation record FDC 2644285 (water 70.8 g, protein 6.91 g). The previous 5.6 value matched no official record. USDA's only canned black bean records, FDC 175188 and the low-sodium FDC 175238, both publish 6.9 g/100 g. Flagged proxy because USDA names the record by the black turtle cultivar rather than generically, and the undrained basis is inferred from the record's water and protein rather than stated in its description. The form-matched Foundation record FDC 2644285 publishes no dietary fiber value at all and so cannot support this row.
